description: Clean run of all 3 desk tickets through the React dashboard, from the original database. All facts are from that run (output/audit_trail.json) and data/campus_customs_new.db.

tickets.subject: Bulldog tee (1 x CC-TEE-WHITE, size S) for Tauhid Zaman
tickets.final_status: resolved: both requests approved by a human; tee restock expected about 2026-09-05; customer draft awaits human review
tickets.dashboard: Resolved (team run complete) - Approved by you
tickets.outcome: Tee was out of stock (0 of 1) and Bulldog Print Co was blocked by overdue invoice 501. The team requested payment of the $840 invoice and an $8 PO for one tee; both were approved by a human, so the vendor is unblocked and the tee is expected about 2026-09-05. Customer reply saved as draft #1 (not sent).

agent_contributions.boss: Read the board, routed the ticket to Inventory, asked Accounting for a restock PO as a new subtask, asked Customer Service for the reply, and set the status to waiting_on_approval.
agent_contributions.inventory: Found 0 of 1 in stock, matched the tee to Bulldog Print Co by specialty (5-day lead time), found invoice 501 blocking shipment, and handed the invoice to Accounting.
agent_contributions.accounting: Confirmed invoice 501 ($840, 3 days overdue) and cash, then created request #1 (invoice payment) and request #2 (PO, 1 tee at $8 unit cost).
agent_contributions.customer_service: Saved draft #1 to Tauhid Zaman: out of stock, about 2026-09-05 as an estimate only, asks whether to wait. Not sent.

human_approvals.effect: Invoice 501 marked paid; Bulldog Print Co can ship again. Checking $3,400.00 -> $2,560.00.
Restock order for 1 x CC-TEE-WHITE S placed; expected arrival 2026-09-05. Checking $2,560.00 -> $2,552.00.

tickets.subject: Rent due - lease 1, Chapel Street shop (Elm City Properties)
tickets.final_status: resolved: rent paid after human approval; next rent due 2026-10-02
tickets.dashboard: Resolved (team run complete) - Approved by you
tickets.outcome: Confirmed $2,400 rent due 2026-09-02 from the lease table. Accounting requested the rent payment, a human approved it, and the lease's next due date moved to 2026-10-02. No message to the landlord.

agent_contributions.boss: Routed the ticket to Facilities and set the status to waiting_on_approval. (Its report listed handled_by as boss and facilities only, leaving out Accounting.)
agent_contributions.facilities: Looked up lease 1 (Chapel Street shop, Elm City Properties, $2,400 due in 2 days) and handed the payment to Accounting. Also made one redundant cash check.
agent_contributions.accounting: Checked cash ($2,552, nothing pending) and created request #3 (rent, $2,400), which would leave $152.

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount - 20 x CC-HOOD-NAVY, size M, for Yale AI Club
tickets.final_status: resolved for the team: offer and option drafted; waiting on the customer's reply (no approvals were needed)
tickets.dashboard: Resolved (team run complete) - Boss status in_progress
tickets.outcome: 8 of 20 in stock (12 short). Restocking 12 would cost $264 against $152 in checking, so no PO was requested. The Boss offered $55 each ($3 off list, $33 margin per unit) and partial fulfillment (8 now, 12 later) as an option. Reply saved as draft #2 (not sent). The ticket stays in_progress, waiting on the club's answer and the $112 funding gap.

agent_contributions.boss: Sent separate tasks to Inventory and Accounting, chose a $55 bulk price, asked Customer Service for the reply, and set the status to in_progress (not blocked).
agent_contributions.inventory: Found 8 of 20 on hand (short 12). Bulldog Print Co can ship now that invoice 501 is paid; 5-day lead time.
agent_contributions.accounting: Laid out the economics: $58 list, $22 cost/break-even, $36 margin (62.1%). Restocking 12 = $264 vs. $152 checking, a $112 shortfall. Created no request.
agent_contributions.customer_service: Saved draft #2 to Yale AI Club: $55 each, 8 available now, the other 12 only if restock is approved; partial fulfillment offered for consideration. Not sent.

note_on_status: boss_status_in_db is the Boss's last update_ticket call, made before the human approvals. Approving a request does not change the ticket's status, so 101 and 102 still read waiting_on_approval even though their approvals were granted.
